FIELDS.NAME: Luminous Designs Lighting Co.
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Bright Light Avenue, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62704-5678
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Operations Manager, Luminous Designs Lighting Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Luminous Designs Lighting Co. specializes in the retail sale of high-quality lighting fixtures, bulbs, and accessories from our inviting physical storefront located in Springfield, IL. Our operations focus on providing exceptional customer service while showcasing a diverse selection of products, including energy-efficient options and stylish designs to enhance any space. We maintain strict inventory management protocols, including regular cycle counts and secure storage, to minimize shrinkage and protect our products. Our commitment to safety is further reflected in our adherence to UL and ANSI standards, and we continuously strive to provide a welcoming, well-lit shopping environment for both residential and commercial customers. Our online sales channel complements our physical presence, maintaining under 75% of total revenue, thereby reducing exposure to shipping losses.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Luminous Automation Solutions LLC, a company specializing in lighting control systems and energy management technology, located at 5678 Tech Lane, Springfield, IL 62704.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: "On June 10, 2023, a theft incident occurred at our Springfield storefront, resulting in a loss of $1,000 worth of lighting fixtures and supplies. The inventory management system flagged the incident, and local authorities were notified. The case remains under investigation, and we have since implemented additional security measures to prevent future occurrences. Total losses to date amount to $2,500."
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Sat 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II, Grade C, UL Label
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm monitoring and nightly security patrols.
